svg.title: BlaBla concept
svg.desc: Human intent is written into executable project memory, a project manifest with behavior and structure contracts. A coding agent reads that memory through blabla status and explain, writes an ordinary implementation, and runs blabla finish, which verifies both layers and reports OVERALL GREEN only when every active contract is satisfied.
